film: 為什麼我開發 Mografy (scenes/main.ts, story-world.ts): a personal story film. Dark 'black box' half (prompt makes a video, every edit regenerates it), the box opens into light at 27.7 s, an editable system, a +0.5 s edit that touches one clip, four people Mografy is for, describing motion to AI, the closing line, the brand logo animation and URL.

sections.name: question
sections.note: The question, one prompt makes a video, can we still control it?

sections.name: regenerate
sections.note: Every small edit regenerates the whole video; versions pile up into the black box.

sections.name: idea
sections.note: Versions dropped into the slowly turning box; code cards fall in one by one; the lid swings open and light floods in at 27.7.

sections.name: system
sections.note: Scenes, time, params, components; the +0.5 s edit; four people, one line each.

sections.name: statement
sections.note: Describe it to AI; 'let AI speed up the making, leave the final decisions with the creator'.

sections.name: logo
sections.note: Prompt bubble, brand logo animation (light), URL at the bottom.

hits.note: the black box opens and the light floods in
logo locks up with the wordmark; hold

note: User is strict about music: no noisy or fragmented sounds. 'sustained' rhythm = pads, one soft piano chord per bar (slow attack, no hammer noise), a held bass. No whoosh, impact, pops, ticks, bells or arpeggios.
